Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> blames herself for failing the quest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼に失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、自分を責め始めた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 未能完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>感到相当自责。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 未能完成委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>感到相當自責。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se blâme d'avoir échoué la quête.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> machte sich selbst Vorwürfe, weil sie die Quest nicht erfolgreich abgeschlossen hatte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se culpó por fallar la misión.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: A <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> culpou-se por falhar na missão.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ตำหนิตัวเองที่ทำภารกิจล้มเหลว
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menyalahkan dirinya sendiri karena gagal dalam misi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tự trách mình vì đã thất bại trong nhiệm vụ.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: अपने मिशन में विफल रहने के लिए <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> खुद को दोषी ठहराती है।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: You can do better next time.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 次はうまくやればいいさ。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Tu feras mieux la prochaine fois.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Nächstes Mal schaffst du es besser.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: La próxima vez lo harás mejor.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Você pode fazer melhor da próxima vez.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ครั้งหน้าทำให้ดีขึ้นก็ได้ครับ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Kamu bisa melakukan yang lebih baik lain kali.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Lần tới cứ làm tốt hơn là được.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: अगली बार तुम बेहतर कर सकती हो।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: I have a Vitality Potion. Want to drink it?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションがあるけど、飲む？
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: J'ai une Potion de Vitalité. Tu veux en boire une ?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Ich habe einen Vitalitätstrank. Möchtest du ihn trinken?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Tengo una Poción de Vitalidad. ¿Quieres beberla?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Tenho uma Poção de Vitalidade. Quer beber?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: มีโพชั่นพลังชีวิตอยู่ ดื่มไหมครับ?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Aku punya Ramuan Vitalitas. Mau minum?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Tôi có một bình Thuốc Hồi Phục Sức Sống. Cô muốn uống không?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: मेरे पास एक जीवन शक्ति औषधि है। क्या तुम इसे पीना चाहोगी?

Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、団長の寛大さに、驚いたようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎对团长的宽宏大量感到惊讶。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎對團長的寬宏大量感到驚訝。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semblait étonné par la générosité du chef.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> schien von der Großzügigkeit des Kommandanten überrascht zu sein.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Parece que <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se ha sorprendido por la gran generosidad del líder.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parecia surpreso(a) com a generosidade do chefe.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูเหมือนจะประหลาดใจกับความเอื้อเฟื้อเผื่อแผ่ของกัปตัน
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tampak terkejut dengan kebaikan hati sang Komandan.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> có vẻ ngạc nhiên trước sự hào phóng của Đội trưởng.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> कप्तान की उदारता से हैरान लग रही थी।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> seemed uneasy, wondering if there would ever be a next time.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、次の機会があるのかと不安そうにしていた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>对于是否还有下次机会感到不安。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>對於是否還有下次機會感到不安。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semblait mal à l'aise, se demandant s'il y aurait une prochaine fois.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> schien unruhig und fragte sich, ob es jemals ein nächstes Mal geben würde.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parecía inquieto, preguntándose si habría una próxima vez.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parecia inquieto(a), perguntando-se se haveria uma próxima vez.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ดูไม่สบายใจ สงสัยว่าจะไม่มีโอกาสครั้งหน้าอีกแล้ว
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tampak gelisah, bertanya-tanya apakah akan ada lain kali.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> có vẻ không yên tâm, tự hỏi liệu có lần sau nữa không.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> बेचैन लग रही थी, यह सोचकर कि क्या अगली बार ऐसा कभी होगा।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est égayé après avoir reçu la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hellte sich auf, nachdem sie den Trank erhalten hatte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animó después de recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> animou-se depois de receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดีใจเมื่อได้รับยาโพชั่น
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tươi tỉnh hẳn lên sau khi nhận được bình thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: औषधि मिलने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> का चेहरा खिल उठा।
